evidence_required: .memory-bank/features/FT-016.md#FT-016-AC-001: RED: with a quoted free selection, changing the venue to paid before its new-order POST currently yields a rejected request without the accepted recovery message; visible retry can repeat the same known-rejected free POST. Existing mixed paid/free browser order, email and frozen-order integration still pass. purpose: Restore an ordinary visitor path when current paid settings invalidate a previously free quote before creating an order.
success_outcome: The served browser explains the changed conditions and allows a fresh selection without automatic purchase continuation.
anti_goals: No server/API/schema/provider changes, automatic purchase retry, new client history or polling layer; created orders retain their frozen amount and free flags.

forbidden_scope: Production/deploy, real payment/email, shared operator database or destructive probes
Server order/payment owners, shared API/schema, unrelated Promo/QR and other feature behavior
stop_conditions: A repair requires a server/shared contract or changed product behavior, or the browser cannot distinguish a safe ordinary new selection within accepted behavior.

constraints: Planning Revision 4 and Constitution KISS; advisory paths do not restrict necessary task-local fixture edits.
invariants: promo server remains order/payment authority; browser never infers paid entitlement or overwrites frozen order state.
TASK-139 stays failed with exhausted retry budget; supplier proof belongs to done tasks.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-001: In the actual served browser with isolated backend and fake provider, quote a free selected photo, hold the new-order POST, switch its venue free-to-paid through the existing fixture, then release it. Establish the changed condition from current server conditions rather than HTTP 422 alone. Observe the old request rejected without an order or provider call, the exact accepted message, ordinary new selection obtaining the current server quote, and visible retry not looping the known-rejected old free POST; no automatic POST/payment navigation follows the old selection. Deliberate user retry after a fresh selection/quote remains available.

FT-016-AC-001: Separately inject an unrelated POST validation/error and an ambiguous POST outcome in the served fixture. The unrelated failure must not display the changed-conditions message. After the ambiguous outcome, a user retry preserves exactly the same request body and client_request_id, yields at most one order, and has zero automatic continuation; compare POST payloads/counts, order identity and UI state.

FT-016-AC-001: Focused unit and served regression also cover ordinary mixed-venue paid/free selection, browser email/method submission, one saved profile email/last visit, and already created order amount/free flags remaining server-frozen. Use disposable fixture state, safe rerun and cleanup; report observed network/UI/profile/order values and compare with the criterion. Existing TASK-132/137/138 server supplier proofs are prerequisites, not this task's claims.
